label: Another actual cause of being is a q.3 a.4 external cause of esse, by definition
meaning: Premise-free: for every q.3 a.4 profile, a distinct being in act as to being that causes x's being (CAUSING_AN_EFFECT_3) witnesses x's external cause of esse (CAUSING_AN_EFFECT_2). This holds by the Lean definition of HasExternalEsseCause and adds only distinctness and actuality; it does not make any cause of being efficient, since that reading of the q.3 a.4 sense is carried in prose, not in the type. Recorded as the explicit sense bridge.
